scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
class_rule: on K2 components: ask_time_bound (between_puts < .1, before_first_ask >= .1) | schedule_bound (>= .1, < .1) | immune | both | silent
readouts: class-preservation share per variant (Wilson), stratified by reward lost / kept; mean L1 distance to the base vector; whether persist_none collapses vectors to immunity

predictions.STRUCTURAL: class preserved in >= 2/3 of damaged programs that LOST reward
predictions.ENTANGLED_WITH_LENGTH: pad or duplicate change the class in >= 1/3
predictions.ONE_NODE: persist_none collapses >= 2/3 of vectors to immune (T-X15 and T-X17 share the coordinate)

material_rule: any prediction's threshold met with its Wilson band clear of the complementary threshold
